titulo: Jacinda Ardern and husband Clarke Gayford buy $5.3m home in Sydney’s northern beaches
cuerpo: Former New Zealand prime minister’s purchase is the highest sale price recorded in suburb of Dee Why this year Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Jacinda Ardern and her husband, Clarke Gayford, have bought a $5.3m home in Sydney’s northern beaches, according to a source with knowledge of the sale.
